text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The right to compete in the Arima Kinen is decided by the popular vote of racing fans.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Thanks to her accomplishments in the Classics, Mejiro Ryan has earned enough votes to take part in the race.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Senior-year Umamusume, including the "Beast," Oguri Cap, will also be competing in the illustrious race.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Intimidated by all the extraordinary entrants she will be facing, Mejiro Ryan heads off to the race.
